method.training_objective: For each outer fold, maximize document recall on training queries subject to gold-document chunk share staying within the stated absolute drop from global BM25; ties prefer higher chunk share, then the stricter gate.
method.deployment_route: The fixed InsightEdge multi-source intent rule selects which queries receive the gate.
method.score_gate: Admit an outside-top-k source candidate only if its FTS5 BM25 magnitude is at least ratio times the original kth candidate's magnitude.

limitations: The held-out folds are query-level splits from one synthetic enterprise benchmark; they are not an independent corpus or domain replication.
The source-coverage intent route is fixed during this evaluation but was previously inspected on this benchmark.
Gold labels identify supporting documents, not relevant passages; gold-document chunk share is a proxy, not citation entailment.
This isolates BM25 retrieval and evidence selection; it does not establish end-to-end hybrid RAG answer quality.
